{{Quote|You Mirialans crazy.|[[Musk (Nikto)|Musk]]|<ref name="The Old Republic: Smuggler's Vanguard">{{SWArchive|url=games/videgames/tor_smugglersvanguard/index.html|text=''The Old Republic: Smuggler's Vanguard''|int=The Old Republic: Smuggler's Vanguard}}</ref>}}
'''Mirialans''' were a species of [[near-Human]]s<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> native to the planet [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]]. Their appearance varied from yellow-green skin to paler skin very similar to many [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Mirialans were very flexible and agile, making them fast and formidable foes.<ref name="Star Wars: Force and Destiny Roleplaying Game">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beta|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Beta]]</ref>

==Biology==
{{Main|Human/Legends}}
A near-Human species, Mirialans were nearly physiologically identical to Humans. The greatest difference in their biology was their green skin, great agility and extremely quick reflexes. The latter traits gave them the upper hand over Humans in terms of reaction time, athletics and martial arts.<ref name="FaD" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:MirialanMale-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Mirialan male during the Cold War]]
The Mirialan people were deeply religious and practiced a primitive understanding of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. They believed each individual's actions contributed to their destiny, building upon past successes and failures to drive them towards their fates. A Mirialan would place a unique, often geometrically repeated [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on their face and hands to signify that they had completed a certain test or task, or achieved sufficient aptitude for a certain skill. The number of tattoos would thus often act as a good indicator of how mature and/or skilled a Mirialan was.<ref name="FaD" />

Because the more markings brought about a form of status, Mirialan society was stratified and allowed the heavily marked citizens to access greater opportunities. Despite its importance, most Mirialans did not know the entirety of the tattoo lexicon due to its complexity. The interaction between placement and positioning of the shapes was incredibly subtle and changed the meaning greatly.<ref name="FaD" />

Within their belief system was the view that individual actions ripple through the Force, also affecting the destiny of the species as a whole.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Because the Force was understood through the notion of the [[Cosmic Force/Legends|Cosmic Force]] on a basic level, the cultural significance of the energy was defined as fate. Those who were not sensitive to its call still had faith in fate, and felt that it guided their lives. Mirialans always had a presence within the ranks of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="FaD" />

[[Eckard Lokin|Doctor Eckard Lokin]], a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], recalled a shared interest in Mirialan cuisine with his colleague [[Cipher Twelve]] during a conversation with the Imperial agent known as [[Cipher Nine]].

==History==
[[File:Jedi Shadow Force and Destiny.jpg|left|thumb|250px|A Mirialan [[Jedi Shadow]] stands on a ledge, overlooking a city.]]
Following the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] return and invasion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], sparking the [[Great Galactic War]], the Mirialans promoted their planet as a safe haven for refugees from the Outer Rim. This surge of victims of war led a large number of Mirialans to enlist in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], and others to utilise their abilities in the Force with the Jedi.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia" />

At some point before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]] fought in a [[Mirialan War|war]] against a nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The notorious [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Arwen Cohl]] helped lead the Mirialans to victory.<ref name="Cloak">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

==Mirialans in the galaxy==
[[File:Luminara_TCW.jpg|right|thumb|Luminara Unduli during the Clone Wars]]
[[Hylo Visz]] was a Mirialan [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] who led a coalition of smugglers to break a [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|Mandalorian blockade]] and deliver raw goods to Coruscant.<ref name="TORtl2">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref>

[[Arwen Cohl]] was active as a Mirialan freedom fighter decades before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Cloak" /> [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] were Mirialan [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref> [[Teela Kaarz]] was a political prisoner who worked as a minor architect on the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mirialans are a playable species in the Star Wars MMO ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class,<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> the [[Jedi Consular]] class,<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] class,<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and the [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] class.<ref name="Jeux">{{WebCite|url=http://www.jeuxonline.info/actualite/28133/gamescom-2010-interview-sean-dahlberg|text=GamesCom 2010 : Interview de Sean Dahlberg|work=JeuxOnline|archivedate=20171022200823}}</ref> Completing any of these storylines with a Mirialan character will unlock the race as an option for all other character classes; alternatively, the race can be unlocked through purchase in the Cartel Market.
